prompt.project_info: Create an ultra-detailed photorealistic highland lake selfie in warm daylight.
prompt.main_subject: Approved adult woman with long straight light-brown hair, clear blue eyes, natural makeup, realistic skin texture, and relaxed warm smile, wearing an elegant sleeveless white V-neck jumpsuit or dress with secure coverage, button details, and matching belt.
prompt.composition_elements: True iPhone-style selfie at arm's length with mild wide-angle distortion, relaxed shoulders and slightly tilted head, wooden railing, green reeds, reflective lake, reddish-brown mountains, rolling hills, and partly cloudy blue sky.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Warm sunny natural light with soft hair highlights, balanced exposure, realistic environmental depth, vibrant yet natural colors, immersive outdoor storytelling.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic professional mobile photography, 8K-style detail, sharp face, subtle background blur, realistic hair strands, natural shadows, high dynamic range.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Ultra-detailed photorealistic iPhone-style selfie of an approved adult woman with long straight light brown hair flowing over her shoulders, clear blue eyes, natural makeup, realistic skin texture, soft peach blush, lightly glossed lips, and a relaxed warm smile. She holds the camera at arm's length with mild smartphone wide-angle distortion, relaxed shoulders, and a slight head tilt. She wears an elegant sleeveless white V-neck jumpsuit or dress with secure coverage, refined vertical button details, lightweight structured fabric, and a matching belt. A wooden railing and green reeds frame a scenic highland lake; calm reflective water, reddish-brown mountains, rolling hills, and partly cloudy blue sky fill the background. Use warm sunny natural light, crisp jewelry highlights, balanced exposure, realistic hair, natural shadows, 8K-style mobile photography, and immersive environmental detail.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, underage, childlike, deep plunge, exposed cleavage, transparent clothing, body-part emphasis, sexualized pose, nudity, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, extra fingers, deformed, public figure likeness.
